test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which counsel represented India at The International Court of Justice at The Hague, against Pakistan's decision of awarding the death sentence to Kulbhushan Jadhav?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harish Salve.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harish Salve** fought the case of Kulbhushan Jadhav at the International Court of Justice.
 
• Kulbhushan Sudhir Jadhav is an Indian national. It is alleged by the Pakistani government that he was arrested in the Pakistani province of Balochistan on** charges of terrorism and spying for India's intelligence agency, the Research and Analysis Wing.**
 
• Harish Salve is an Indian senior advocate who practices at the Supreme Court of India. He served as the Solicitor General of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Int**ernational Court of Justice**, sometimes known as the World Court, is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations.
 
• It settles disputes between states in accordance with international law and gives advisory opinions on international legal issues.
